iuvare: iuvō, -āre, iūvī, iūtum — to help, aid, benefit (pres. inf.)
languida: languidus, -a, -um — faint, drowsy, sluggish (f. nom. sg., with quiēs)
letalemque: lētālis, -e — deadly, fatal (m. acc. sg., with sonum) + -que, and

orasque: ōra, -ae (f.) — edge, rim, border, coast (f. acc. pl.) + -que, and

saxumve: saxum, -ī (n.) — rock, stone, boulder (n. acc. sg.) + -ve, or
scelerato: scelerātus, -a, -um — accursed, guilty, impious (m. abl. sg., with sanguine)
septemplicis: septemplex, -icis — sevenfold, of seven layers (m. gen. sg., with clipeī)
sermo: sermō, -ōnis (m.) — speech, talk, words (m. nom. sg.)

succidimus: succidō, -ere, -cidī — to sink down, give way, collapse (1st pl. pres. ind.)

varii: varius, -a, -um — varied, changing, diverse (m. nom. pl., with sensūs)
